migration-ownedcomposerstatus--landing-w.expression: () => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] [role=status]'); const textarea=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] textarea'); return element && textarea && textarea.value==='Review the current changes.' && element.textContent==="Choose a project before sending." && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='polite' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).visibility==='visible' && getComputedStyle(element).color!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; }

migration-ownedcomposerstatus--session-w.expression: () => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] [role=status]'); const textarea=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] textarea'); return element && textarea && textarea.value==='Review the current changes.' && element.textContent==="Choose a project before sending." && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='polite' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).visibility==='visible' && getComputedStyle(element).color!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; }

migration-ownedcomposerstatus--long-warn.expression: () => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] [role=status]'); const textarea=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] textarea'); return element && textarea && textarea.value==='Review the current changes.' && element.textContent==="Choose a project on the selected machine before sending this message. The current project is unavailable; select another project or reconnect the machine and try again." && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='polite' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).visibility==='visible' && getComputedStyle(element).color!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; }

migration-ownedcomposerstatus--info.expression: () => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] [role=status]'); const textarea=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] textarea'); return element && textarea && textarea.value==='Review the current changes.' && element.textContent==="Select a project to continue." && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='polite' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).visibility==='visible' && getComputedStyle(element).color!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; }

migration-ownedcomposerstatus--error.expression: () => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] [role=alert]'); const textarea=document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-fixture] textarea'); return element && textarea && textarea.value==='Review the current changes.' && element.textContent==="A project is required." && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='assertive' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).visibility==='visible' && getComputedStyle(element).color!=='rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; }

migration-ownedcomposerstatus--scoped-pa.expression: () => ['dark','light','self'].every(scope => { const element=document.querySelector('[data-status-scope='+scope+'] [role=status]'); return element && element.getAttribute('aria-live')==='polite' && element.textContent==='Choose a project before sending.' && element.getBoundingClientRect().height>0 && getComputedStyle(element).color===({dark:'rgb(20, 142, 107)',light:'rgb(111, 47, 189)',self:'rgb(34, 91, 173)'})[scope]; })

steps.expression: () => document.querySelector('#status-prompt')?.value==='Updated prompt.' && document.querySelector('[data-composer-status-result]')?.textContent.includes('Updated prompt.') && document.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent==='Choose a project before sending.'
